questions.question: How do you install an npm module globally?
questions.expected_answer: Add the -g flag to the install command, for example npm install -g nodemon@1.18.5. Globally installed modules are not added as dependencies in package.json and are not placed in node_modules.

evidence.text: npm modules can be installed globally by adding a -g flag to the installation command.

questions.question: What does nodemon do?
